description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Attach Lightning with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Chant Mode I (Garnet - Lightning)] and [Lightning Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Chant Mode I (Garnet - Lightning)
description.text: Summoning and Bard abilities trigger 1 additional time, Summoning and Bard abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, cast speed x3.00 for Summoning and Bard abilities, causes [Imperil Lightning 10% (5s)] after using Summoning abilities, grants [Quick Cast 2] to all allies once per battle after using a Bard ability, Summoning smart ether 2 to the user once per battle after using a Bard ability

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Chant Mode II (Garnet - Lightning)], removes [Dual Awoken Chant Mode I (Garnet - Lightning)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Chant Mode II (Garnet - Lightning)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 10000, cast speed x2.00/2.25/2.50/2.75/3.00 for Summoning and Bard abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Summoning and Bard abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Dual Light of Protection after using Summoning and Bard abilities

description.name: Dual Light of Protection
description.text: Restores 2000 HP, grants [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1]

description.name: 40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 40% for the next attack

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3
